findings.description: The single-file wrap check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain `str` filename is no longer wrapped in a tuple.
findings.rationale: Trigger: calling `edit(filename="notes.txt")` with a plain str. The str is not PathLike, so it skips the wrap and goes to `ed.edit_files(filenames="notes.txt")`, which iterates the string character by character. Impact: the editor is launched on files named `n`, `o`, `t`, and so on, instead of `notes.txt`. This breaks the existing str usage that the title does not intend to change.
